items.title: 68090_Ed Garland oral history interview
items.q: All right, me and him work pretty good together.

ctx.x: I don't know if you heard of him, Henry -- ah, Henry's name? Wonderful piano player when I was on KFI.
How about the pianists you're working with now, Alton Parker, Alvin Pernell.
All right, me and him work pretty good together.
